title: ExtractedInvoice
description: Unified JSON schema contract for structured utility bill data extracted via Gemini Vision or external parsers.

version.description: Schema version indicator for backward compatibility and migration control

periodLabel.description: Human-readable billing period as printed on the invoice

periodStart.description: Optional ISO start date of billing period (YYYY-MM-DD)

periodEnd.description: Optional ISO end date of billing period (YYYY-MM-DD)

consumptionUnit.description: Consumption unit: kwh for electricity, m3 for water

amountSar.description: Total bill amount in Saudi Riyals (must be non-negative)

accountNumber.description: Account number, meter number, or subscriber ID
